mapper.update: UPDATE afv_canvas_export_blob SET state='READY',stored_bytes=#{bytes},update_time=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND export_id=#{exportId} AND owner_epoch=#{epoch} AND state='STAGING'
UPDATE afv_canvas_export_blob SET state='ORPHANED',update_time=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE export_id=#{id} AND state='STAGING'
mapper.select: SELECT b.* FROM afv_canvas_export_blob b WHERE b.state='ORPHANED' AND b.update_time<=TIMESTAMPADD(DAY,#{days},UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM afv_canvas_export j WHERE j.blob_id=b.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM afv_canvas_export_event e WHERE e.export_id=b.export_id AND e.event_type='FILE_PURGE_RETRY' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.detail_json,'$.blobId'))=b.id AND e.create_time>TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR,-1,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))) ORDER BY b.update_time,b.id LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM afv_canvas_export_blob WHERE id=#{id} AND export_id=#{exportId} AND state='ORPHANED' AND update_time<=TIMESTAMPADD(DAY,#{days},UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_canvas_export_blob SET state='PURGED',encryption_keyset=X'',update_time=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND state='ORPHANED'
